title: rumex verticillatus subsp. fascicularis
intro: Rumex verticillatus subsp. fascicularis, commonly known as Water Dock, is a perennial plant species in the buckwheat family Polygonaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its use as a diuretic, to help treat urinary tract infections and kidney stones. The therapeutic actions of Rumex verticillatus subsp. fascicularis include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and anthraquinones, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
